title: Weekly report
description: Compare retained records for a completed week and explain changes in their API-equivalent amount.
generated: Generated {time} · Cached for up to 10 minutes.
loading: Reading weekly records and calculation evidence…
observedOnly: Based on records included in this report
basis: These are API-rate equivalents from stored usage and pricing evidence, not subscription charges or an actual invoice.
coverage: Current week: {unpriced} unpriced · {estimated} estimated · {legacy} legacy events. {excluded} events across both weeks are excluded from the driver analysis.
unpricedNotice: Unpriced records have no amount included in the total. A lower recorded amount does not establish actual savings.
updating: Generated during ingestion or repair activity. Amounts reflect the records read by this query and may change later.
empty: No retained records in the comparison period.

drivers.title: Drivers of the recorded change
drivers.description: Only model groups with reproducible evidence in both periods are decomposed. Other amounts remain unclassified.
drivers.evidence: Amounts analyzed: {previous} in the previous week → {current} in the current week.

health.title: Current collection status
health.description: Checked {time}. This is not a historical incident record or proof of usage during the reported week.
health.caution: Missing records do not mean no AI use. Scope changes, missing data and repairs can also affect the comparison. An em dash means unknown.

methodology.title: Method and pricing evidence
methodology.average: Each contribution is averaged over every ordering of the five factors. Changing the order cannot assign the difference to a preferred factor. This is an arithmetic decomposition, not evidence of causality.
methodology.missing: If either period lacks pricing or calculation evidence for a model, that model is excluded from both sides of the decomposition. New models or unobserved token buckets borrow the other period’s observed composition or rates; unobserved price changes are not invented.
methodology.rates: Effective rates reflect price revisions, long-context tiers, fast mode and the distribution of requests within a model. Do not interpret this contribution as a vendor price increase alone.
methodology.scope: Scope-setting project paths and conversation text are not included. Team reports use membership at event time; collection status describes current connections.

errors.denied: You cannot access this report scope. Team reports require the team leader or an administrator; organization reports require an administrator.
errors.period: Check the scope and week. Reports require a completed Sunday-start week and a fully retained comparison interval.
errors.unavailable: The report could not be completed. Partial results have not been presented as a finished report. Try again shortly.

outboxNotice: Server delivery is not yet confirmed for {count} events in the comparison interval. The current query may not include all of them.
noBaseline: There are no records for the previous week. This shows newly observed records, not proof of an equivalent increase in actual usage.
